# Blazify

> A free, open-source music player for Android, Windows, Linux and iPhone.
> Streams millions of songs, plays them offline, and shows word-by-word synced
> lyrics. No advertising, no tracking, no account required, no paid tier.

Blazify is made by Rajendra Pandey in Kathmandu, Nepal, and licensed under
GPL-3.0. Its official website is https://rajendra7169.github.io/blazify/ and its
source is at https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify

Not to be confused with blazify.org, an unrelated marketing company, or with
Blaze Player, an unrelated application.

## What it is

An alternative to Spotify Free and YouTube Music Free for people who do not
want advertisements, do not want to pay, and do not want to be tracked. Unlike
those free tiers it plays any song on demand rather than shuffling, allows
offline downloads without a subscription, and continues playing with the screen
off.

## Features

- Streams millions of songs; search or browse songs, albums, artists, playlists
- Word-by-word synced lyrics, with translation and romanisation
- Ten-band equalizer with 13 presets, bass boost and reverb
- Offline downloads, and songs kept automatically as you play them
- Background playback and gapless playback
- Colour taken from the album artwork; Material You theming
- Optional Google sign-in, syncing your YouTube Music library and playlists
- Listen Together: play in sync with friends over a room code
- Backup and restore your whole library to a single file
- Android Auto, home-screen widgets, last.fm scrobbling

## Privacy

No advertising, no analytics and no tracking library of any kind is present in
the source. Nothing is sent anywhere except to services the user switches on.
Signing in is optional; everything except a personal YouTube Music library works
signed out.

## Availability

- Android: https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/releases/latest
- Windows and Linux: https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify-desktop/releases/latest
- Not on the Google Play Store, because apps that stream audio from YouTube are
  removed from it. Installed by sideloading the APK.
